The biopsy finding of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells in the dermis and subcutis, together with retroperitoneal and adrenal masses and failure to improve on antibiotics, strongly supports a lymphoproliferative disorder rather than cellulitis. Unremarkable peripheral flow cytometry and absent lymphatic obstruction do not exclude tissue lymphoma.
